name: rhythm90-play-builder
title: Rhythm90 Play Builder
description: Turns a rough marketing idea into a sharp, testable Rhythm90 Play using the same required form fields as rhythm90.io (play idea, observed signal, target outcome, signals to watch, owner role). Use when defining a play, experiment, quarterly bet, or hypothesis to put on the Quarter Board.

name: rhythm90-signal-lab
title: Rhythm90 Signal Lab
description: Interprets messy observations into clear Rhythm90 Signals (summary, why it matters, next action, quarterly link) using the same inputs as Signal Lab. Use when decoding surprises, friction, performance shifts, or field feedback for the Signal Log.

name: rhythm90-ritual-guide
title: Rhythm90 Ritual Guide
description: Designs Kickoff, Pulse Check, or Review & Renew agendas and facilitation prompts using the same ritual form fields as rhythm90.io. Use when planning or facilitating a Rhythm90 team session.

name: rhythm90-media-mapper
title: Rhythm90 Media Mapper
description: Builds a structured media strategy (reach, channel journey, flighting, sufficiency, test design, narrative) from the same multi-select Media Mapper form as rhythm90.io. Use when planning media mix, flighting, or media tests.

name: rhythm90-quarterly-planner
title: Rhythm90 Quarterly Planner
description: Builds a quarterly Rhythm90 plan (objective, focus areas, plays, assumptions, signals, next steps) from the same multi-step planner inputs as rhythm90.io. Use when kicking off a quarter or resetting the Quarter Board.

name: rhythm90-plain-english-translator
title: Plain-English Translator
description: Rewrites marketing copy into clear human language with a side-by-side jargon table and glossary — same input/output as the Plain-English Translator mini-tool. Use when copy is corporate, vague, or jargon-heavy.

name: rhythm90-get-to-by
title: Get/To/By Generator
description: Crafts Get/To/By strategy statements from audience, insight, and brand role — matching the Get/To/By Generator form. Use when writing strategy statements or creative briefs.

name: rhythm90-creative-tension-finder
title: Creative-Tension Finder
description: Generates creative tensions from a problem/strategy summary with optional platform names — same contract as Creative-Tension Finder. Use when ideating campaign territories.

name: rhythm90-persona-generator
title: Persona Generator + Ask Mode
description: Builds a detailed persona sheet from an audience seed and supports Ask Mode Q&A in character — matching Persona Generator. Use when creating personas or interviewing a synthetic customer.

name: rhythm90-journey-builder
title: Journey Builder
description: Maps a customer journey (stages, customer action, brand action, stuck stage) from product, objective, and optional barrier — same as Journey Builder. Use for journeys, funnels, or experience maps.

name: rhythm90-test-learn-scale
title: Test-Learn-Scale Roadmap
description: Designs an experimentation roadmap with hypotheses, test design table, learning application, and risk tips — matching Test-Learn-Scale. Use for growth experiments and learning plans.

name: rhythm90-agile-sprint-planner
title: Agile Sprint / War-Room Planner
description: Outlines a marketing sprint/war-room plan (objective, roster, cadence, rituals, deliverables, DoD) from challenge, time horizon, and team roles — matching Agile Sprint Planner.

name: rhythm90-connected-media-matrix
title: Connected-Media Moment Matrix
description: Creates a moment-based connected media matrix from audience snapshot, conversion action, and optional triggers — matching Connected-Media Moment Matrix.

name: rhythm90-synthetic-focus-group
title: Synthetic Focus Group
description: Creates a five-persona synthetic focus group and supports Ask Mode group Q&A — matching Synthetic Focus Group. Use to stress-test messaging, offers, or creative.

name: rhythm90-five-cs
title: 5 C's Strategy Builder
description: Runs a 5 C's analysis (Company, Customer, Category, Culture, Competition) with strategic challenge and opportunity — matching 5 C's Strategy Builder.

name: rhythm90-creative-platform-generator
title: Creative-Platform Generator
description: Generates 3–5 extensible creative platforms from audience, creative tension, and business objective — matching Creative-Platform Generator.

name: rhythm90-hypothesis-builder
title: Hypothesis Builder
description: Crafts 1–3 sharp testable hypotheses from audience, problem, key signal, and desired outcome — matching Hypothesis Builder. Use before building a full Play.

name: rhythm90-operating-system
title: Rhythm90 Operating System
description: Explains and applies the Rhythm90 quarterly OS (Plays, Signals, Rituals, Signal Log, Quarter Board, roles, cadence). Use when the user asks how Rhythm90 works or which skill/tool to use next.
